thesis: PGNY is a fundamentally improving, profitable, cash-generative company in a clean uptrend after a post-earnings gap that has held for two weeks on lighter-volume consolidation just under the 52-week high. Growth is accelerating and forward P/E is well below trailing, so the move is backed by earnings. It also sits in a health-care-adjacent niche, while the regime is risk-off and tech-led, so it is not part of the sector under the heaviest pressure. The setup is only a conditional buy: it is extended (RSI 73), reward/risk is modest, and the regime is a headwind. The only attractive entry is a pullback into the 35.3-36.2 zone with the stop under the post-earnings low, or an add on a volume-confirmed close above 37.21. This is a weak-to-moderate long, not a conviction one.
